purchase_identity: One durable tenant/store/package purchase_id before any source call; a new request key, whole batch retry, null lookup or service reconstruction never permits another purchase.
authorization: Current kernel action.propose, distinct owner/reviewer action.approve, action.execute and operation.dispatch; current source/resource/quote/account/rate bindings and diagnostic.label.purchase execution stops; recovery egress interlock.
quote_authority: New purchases require the currently held CarrierQuotes instance to revalidate the original sealed G01 snapshot. Stored commands and old HMACs only identify already sent effects after restart.
approval: Per-package immutable command digest, approver identity and current authority revision, bounded expiry, one consumed use and explicit revocation. Separate reviewed void command.
money: Canonical unsigned decimal minor-unit strings, supported currencies and exact BigInt sums grouped by currency; confirmed native refund reference and original amount required for refunded.
privacy: Each row has one tenant/store/resource/package. No session token or token hash is retained. Erasure keeps minimal original identity and financial audit while scrubbing private references and making replay impossible.
limits: No relabelling an already purchased package
No outbound HTTP route or background worker
